records.title: Beyond the 1/d link threshold in higher-dimensional Abelian Cayley complexes
records.statement: For each fixed integer d>=3 and fixed 0<lambda<1/d, construct explicit families of Abelian Cayley complexes over F_2^n with codimension-two local spectral norm at most lambda and Cayley degree polynomial in n. Weighted complexes are permitted in the source formulation.
records.locator: Section6, first bullet; also paragraph after Theorem1.3
records.domain: Spectral random walks and probabilistic combinatorics
records.first_attack: Identify and overcome the exact 1/d link eigenmode; increasing the product-complex dimension alone is explicitly ruled out by the source.
records.author_progress: PRODUCT_COMPLEX_LINK_BARRIER.md proves a cycle/cochain obstruction for every positive reweighting of the graph-product family; the source open problem remains unsolved.
records.next_step: Seek higher-dimensional relations that do not factor through a base graph; altering the product weights or base expander alone cannot cross the threshold.

records.title: Near-linear or linear degree for strong two-dimensional Abelian Cayley link expansion
records.statement: For fixed 0<lambda<1/2, reduce the degree of the source simple unweighted two-dimensional Cayley complexes over F_2^n to n^(1+o(1)), or to O_lambda(n), while retaining two-sided lambda expansion of every vertex link.
records.domain: Spectral random walks and probabilistic combinatorics
records.counting_rule: One question family; do not count near-linear and linear alternatives as two solved problems.
records.first_attack: Improve nullity per column in the binary relation-matrix construction, keeping row-span minimum distance and real Gram spectral control distinct.

records.title: Stronger expansion for polynomial-degree Abelian Cayley complexes
records.statement: Determine whether polynomial-degree Abelian Cayley complexes can satisfy the stronger expansion assumptions used in low-soundness agreement testing, including the relevant coboundary or cosystolic expansion of associated faces complexes.
records.locator: Section6, third bullet, with referenced definitions [DDL24], [BLM24], [HR26]
records.domain: High-dimensional random walks and probabilistic combinatorics
records.first_attack: Read the cited face-complex definitions before fixing quantifiers; a local eigenvalue bound alone is not cosystolic expansion.
